Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted in the "Analysis of Previous Result" that the 2014 FIFA World Cup was hosted by South Africa. This is factually wrong; the 2014 World Cup was hosted by Brazil (South Africa hosted the 2010 World Cup). Although the WebSurfer correctly identified the year 2014, the Planner's hallucination regarding the host country led to the final incorrect answer of "South Africa" instead of "Brazil".
